decisions.reason: As a multi-model dental line closely tied to the firm's laboratory workflow business, the accumulated investment and earlier public launch make management likely to continue backing it absent clear evidence of failure.
This thermoforming blank sits very near the firm's core dental materials offering, so sunk development and commercialization effort support continued commitment rather than withdrawal.
The intraoral contrast spray remains strategically connected to digital dental workflows, and management can still justify keeping it as part of the firm's broader digital offering.
A custom earmold line fits the firm's established hearing-care capabilities and specialist channels, which makes management inclined to persist with it after several years of commitment.

Although hearing protection earmolds are somewhat more adjacent and less prominently presented, they still build on existing earmold competence, so management would more likely continue than admit the extension was mistaken.
